description_en: Creates a dataset version. Currently supports DataWorks datasets only, with a maximum of 20 versions
description_zh: 创建数据集版本，当前仅支持DataWorks数据集，支持最大版本数为20
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-dataset-version --dataset-id dataworks-dataset:3pXXXb8o0ngr07njhps1 --comment this_is_a_comment --url oss://test-oss-bucket/test_dir/ --mount-path /mnt/data --import-info key=example-string --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatasetVersion

parameters.help_en: The dataset ID. Currently supports DataWorks datasets only
parameters.help_zh: 数据集ID，当前仅支持DataWorks数据集
parameters.name: dataset_id

parameters.help_en: The description for this dataset version. Maximum length: 1,024 characters
parameters.help_zh: 数据集版本描述,长度不超过1024
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The mount path, which must start with /mnt/. Default value: /mnt/data
parameters.help_zh: 挂载路径，需要以/mnt/开头，默认为/mnt/data
parameters.name: mount_path
